facts.statement: Four species of Anabernicula have been described: A. minuscula, A. gracilenta, A. oregonensis, and A. robusta.
facts.quote: Four species have been described: A. minuscula, A. gracilenta, A. oregonensis, and A. robusta

facts.statement: The genus Anabernicula was first described by Ross in 1935.
facts.quote: The genus got described for the first time by Ross in 1935

facts.statement: Anabernicula lived in North America from the Pliocene to the Pleistocene.
facts.quote: Anabernicula is an extinct genus of waterfowl related to shelducks that existed from the Pliocene to the Pleistocene in North America

facts.statement: Anabernicula belongs to the subfamily Anatini.
Anabernicula is classified in the family Anatidae.
Anabernicula lived from the Zanclean age to the Late Pleistocene, between 4.7 and 0.0117 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Zanclean to Late Pleistocene (4.7 to 0.0117 million years ago)
